pr_body:
Closes #13508.

Regressed in #13393. Forgot about seasonal backgrounds... Should have checked all inheritors. Thankfully there are no more now.

The testing is a little indirect (doesn't reside in `TestSceneBackgroundScreenDefault`) but I didn't really want to duplicate the existing testing setup from `TestSceneSeasonalBackgroundLoader`.

issue_context.title: Seasonal backgrounds don't transition to next background
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** When beatmap changes / going back to main menu, it stays on the same background.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
![Kapture 2021-06-15 at 14 06 18](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35318437/122123490-e39dba80-cde2-11eb-90ef-ef0d7a265f6c.gif)


**osu!lazer version:** 	2021.612.0

review_comments: To avoid the oversight in this PR, would it make sense to extract this portion of the check into an `abstract` method inside the base `Background` class?

Sounds like a good idea, if a little tricky when it comes to to typing (would ideally have the implementations of said abstract method declared with params being of the derived type).

I'll see what I can come up with.
Let's go with this fix for now, I'll leave a follow-up PR to you if you can figure a way to improve the safety.
